extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia editors and general readers (those viewing or maintaining the Stephen Colbert biography)
extracted.subtask_description: Maintaining and verifying a Wikipedia biography of a living person; ensuring material is reliably sourced and that contentious or potentially libelous unsourced content is removed promptly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographies of living persons — sourcing and removal of contentious material
rubrics_metrics.description: This section of a biography of a living person needs additional citations for verification. Please help by adding reliable sources. Contentious material about living persons that is unsourced or poorly sourced must be removed immediately from the article and its talk page, especially if potentially libelous.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add reliable sources (news, newspapers, books, scholar, JSTOR, etc.) to verify claims; remove unsourced or poorly sourced contentious material right away. The page also provides a 'Find sources' helper (e.g., 'Stephen Colbert' – news · newspapers · books · scholar · JSTOR) and links to guidance on how and when to remove the BLP notice.
